created_prompt: Can you help me come up with a three-year plan to help me achieve my goals. For background context, I’m a social media influencer with 1.2M followers who posts cooking content, with a focus on quick, healthy recipes. I would love to grow my account even more, and at some point in the next three years publish my own cookbook. I work four days weekly and have a limited budget- I don’t have that much time outside of this work week to spend time on my goals. Could you please give me some advice on what I need to do to grow my following, and how I can progress on my cookbook goal. Please also outline the benefits and disadvantages of traditional publishing and self-publishing and tell me which you think would be better for my situation. Clearly set out an outline for what I need to do over the next three years, maybe dividing each year into quarters and goals I need to achieve in each one.
